svg.title: dbt_utils, installed for real, finds 20 exact duplicates and confirms a clean range
svg.desc: packages.yml declares dbt-labs/dbt_utils version 1.4.1, confirmed current on hub.getdbt.com. dbt deps installs it, adding 116 macros to the project, bringing the total from 477 to 593. dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns, checking the combination of pickup_time, pickup_zone, fare_amount, and total_amount across all 81,013 trips, finds 20 rows that are exact duplicates on every one of the four columns CityFlow's staging model still has -- a real finding, configured with severity warn since the columns Module 1 dropped might have distinguished them. dbt_utils.accepted_range, checking that every pickup_zone falls between 1 and 265, passes cleanly with zero violations, confirming CityFlow's own trip data never references a zone outside the real 265-zone lookup.
svg.text: dbt_utils, Installed for Real, Two Genuine Checks
packages.yml: dbt-labs/dbt_utils 1.4.1 → dbt deps → 477 macros becomes 593
confirmed current on hub.getdbt.com, the same version this course's blueprint pinned before Module 1 started
All four remaining columns match exactly.
Could be real duplicate trips, or two
different trips coinciding on the four
lookup this project loaded in Module 3.
